decisions.reason: With row-major matrices, changing to i-k-j makes the inner j loop access C[i][j] contiguously and reuse A[i][k], whereas the current inner i loop uses strided accesses.

The supplied static evidence identifies stack-resident accumulator traffic; a smaller 2x2 tile reduces accumulator pressure and is more likely to keep accumulators in registers than increasing the tile or reverting to repeated scalar C updates.
